provenance.source: PR #2088 Fix:(issue_2056) Add cmd.XXXArgs() functions for retrieving args, merged 2025-04-19
provenance.note: an args-accessor PR also added a branch that classifies a single-dash argument by its first byte and, when that byte is not a letter, appends it to the positional args with everything after it and returns from the loop; a flag named "4" can therefore never be given as `-4` and a non-ASCII name is misclassified for the same reason, because the byte is read as a rune. The base has no such branch and parses `-4 value` normally, so the PR introduced the defect. Two later fixes repair the two halves of that one branch: 5ec54503ea2c7c703a2509730983507e179f7992 looks the argument up in the applied flags before stopping, and 3b4e832cc97a6be6e440bd1cbf21bb60f57223f6 decodes the first rune instead of a byte

keywords: a flag whose name is not a letter can never be set

bugs.note: the added else-if classifies a single-dash argument by its first byte alone, so a name that is not a letter is appended to the positional args with everything after it and the flag is never applied; the fix looks the argument up in the applied flags first and only stops at an argument that names no flag, and a second fix decodes the first rune rather than a byte
